text:
Ice accumulation on the antenna radome is the most likely cause of link flapping during cold weather.

1. Clear ice from the radome before touching the radio.
2. Check and re-enable ATPC (automatic transmit power control), as firmware 1.4 resets ATPC to off.
3. Check the antenna mount bolts and realign the dish if loose.

Experts disagree on cold weather link drops:
- Erkki Expert (teams, 2024-01-18) reported clearing ice from the radome solved it (worked).
- Another expert noted extreme cold can cause PSU failure even if the radome is clear (never confirmed).

Sources and confidence:
- Radome ice fix: Erkki Expert (teams, 2024-01-18), observed on MW-405.
- ATPC re-enable: confirmed on 3 devices (including MW-405) by Jari Jänne (email, 2023-10-30).
- Mount bolts fix: Jari Jänne (teams, 2024-10-02); applies to microwave links generally, so it may not apply to every device.
